question: Which district has the denser paved road network, Lindenmoor or Redfen, and by how many km of road per square kilometre?

- Redfen: 244.6 km of paved roads and 677.1 km² of area.

Calculations:
- Lindenmoor density = 402.3 ÷ 1,015.7 = 0.396181...
- Redfen density = 244.6 ÷ 677.1 = 0.361423...
- Difference = 0.396181... − 0.361423... = 0.034758...
